sentences.text:
Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice S.K. Sahoo
01. This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Video Conferencing/Physical Mode).

Heard Mr. Subhas Chandra Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with G.R. Case No.1272 of 2022 arising out of Angul P.S. Case No.46 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Angul for offences punishable under sections 419/420/294/506 of the Indian Penal Code.

Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is // 2 // in judicial custody since 25.08.2022 and charge sheet has been submitted under sections 419/420/294/506 of the Indian Penal Code and the offences are triable by Magistrate and the amount of cheating is Rs.20,000/- (rupees twenty thousand) and on hearing the learned counsel for the State, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000.00 Papun @ Aji @ Upendra vs State Of Odisha ....
